📚 1. 15 Từ Vựng Cốt Lõi (Kèm Phát Âm Audio Bản Xứ)

👉 Hãy mở bài học bằng đường link https:// mà giáo viên gửi (bấm vào link trong Zalo ➔ chọn biểu tượng la bàn Safari).
Bấm để máy tự động đọc lần lượt từng từ và hiển thị theo dõi (phù hợp học trên điện thoại)
1. curriculum (n)
/kəˈrɪkjələm/
chương trình học, giáo trình đào tạo
Collocation: academic curriculum, core curriculum
"In the first semester, students learn a new academic curriculum with many different subjects."
2. academic (adj)
/ˌækəˈdemɪk/
thuộc học thuật, học viện
Collocation: academic achievement, academic performance
"Students who maintain high academic performance often receive prestigious scholarships."
3. assignment (n)
/əˈsaɪnmənt/
bài tập, nhiệm vụ nghiên cứu
Collocation: submit an assignment, individual assignment
"We must submit our written assignment before Friday afternoon."
4. concentrate (v)
/ˈkɒnsntreɪt/
tập trung tư tưởng
Collocation: concentrate on studies, struggle to concentrate
"In a noisy environment, it is difficult to concentrate on reading lengthy articles."
5. discipline (n)
/ˈdɪsəplɪn/
tính kỷ luật, sự tự giác
Collocation: self-discipline, maintain academic discipline
"Developing self-discipline is essential for students who study online independently."
6. qualify (v)
/ˈkwɒlɪfaɪ/
đủ điều kiện, đạt chuẩn chứng chỉ
Collocation: qualify for a degree, fully qualified teacher
"After finishing the four-year program, graduates qualify for senior engineering positions."
7. collaborate (v)
/kəˈlæbəreɪt/
cộng tác, làm việc nhóm
Collocation: collaborate with peers, international collaboration
"Group projects encourage undergraduates to collaborate effectively with diverse peers."
8. lecture (n)
/ˈlektʃər/
bài giảng đại học, thuyết trình
Collocation: attend a lecture, guest lecture
"Professor Miller delivered an inspiring lecture on environmental economics this morning."
9. tutor (n)
/ˈtjuːtər/
giảng viên hướng dẫn, gia sư
Collocation: academic tutor, personal tutor
"My personal tutor suggested several academic books to improve my research methodology."
10. revise (v)
/rɪˈvaɪz/
ôn tập, xem lại bài
Collocation: revise for exams, thorough revision
"Dedicated students usually revise their lecture notes every weekend instead of cramming."
11. evaluate (v)
/ɪˈvæljueɪt/
đánh giá, định lượng tiến bộ
Collocation: evaluate student progress, continuous evaluation
"Teachers use interactive quizzes to evaluate how well learners grasp each concept."
12. potential (n)
/pəˈtenʃl/
tiềm năng, khả năng tiềm ẩn
Collocation: reach full potential, academic potential
"An encouraging educational environment helps every student unlock their hidden potential."
13. absorb (v)
/əbˈzɔːb/
tiếp thu, hấp thụ kiến thức
Collocation: absorb complex knowledge, easily absorb
"Active note-taking allows students to absorb complex theories much more effectively."
14. deadline (n)
/ˈdedlaɪn/
hạn chót, thời hạn hoàn thành
Collocation: meet a strict deadline, miss the deadline
"Working under pressure teaches young adults how to meet every strict project deadline."
15. institution (n)
/ˌɪnstɪˈtjuːʃn/
học viện, cơ sở giáo dục đại học
Collocation: higher education institution, prestigious institution
"Cambridge is renowned worldwide as a world-class higher education institution."

⚙️ 2. Bài Giảng Ngữ Pháp 2 Tầng (Grammar Masterclass)

🟢 Tầng 1: Căn Bản (Foundation - Band 3.5 - 4.0)

• Thì Quá khứ đơn (Past Simple): Diễn tả hành động đã hoàn tất trong quá khứ có thời gian xác định (yesterday, last week, two days ago, in 2024).
  Công thức: Khẳng định: S + V2/ed | Phủ định: S + did not (didn't) + V-bare | Nghi vấn: Did + S + V-bare?
  Ví dụ: Yesterday, David submitted his first research assignment.

• Thì Hiện tại hoàn thành (Present Perfect): Diễn tả hành động bắt đầu ở quá khứ và vẫn còn liên hệ tới hiện tại, hoặc kể về trải nghiệm (since, for, already, yet, ever).
  Công thức: S + have / has + V3/ed
  Ví dụ: Emma has studied at this higher education institution for two years.

• Mạo từ A / An / The:
  - A / An: Dùng cho danh từ đếm được số ít nhắc tới lần đầu tiên (a lecture, an assignment).
  - The: Dùng cho đối tượng cả người nói và người nghe đều biết rõ danh tính (the central library, the deadline of this task).

🔵 Tầng 2: Nâng Cao (Band 5.0+ Nuances)

• Câu phức với liên từ phụ thuộc (Complex Sentences): Nâng điểm Coherence & Cohesion bằng các mệnh đề phụ thuộc:
  - Nguyên nhân (Because): Because the curriculum was intensive, students maintained strict self-discipline.
  - Nhượng bộ (Although): Although the assignment was challenging, our team completed it before the deadline.
  - Hành động song song / Cắt ngang (While / When): While the tutor was explaining, students were taking notes actively.

• Bẫy Mạo Từ Học Thuật (Zero Article): Không dùng the trước danh từ số nhiều khi nói về sự việc/con người nói chung:
  ❌ The university students should collaborate... (Sai nếu nói chung chung)
  ✅ University students should collaborate with peers to unlock their potential. (Đúng chuẩn học thuật)

🎯 20 Câu Test Từ Vựng (Vocabulary Mastery Test)

1. In the first semester, students are introduced to the university's official ________.
2. Don't leave your project until Friday night because the final ________ is at 5 PM.
3. Professor Williams delivered a very informative ________ on digital technology this morning.
4. Every student must complete and submit a 1,000-word written ________ by next Monday.
5. Group coursework requires learners to ________ closely with their classmates.
6. Reading textbooks actively helps learners ________ difficult theories more easily.
7. Online learning demands a high degree of self-________ from every participant.
8. Smart students usually ________ their lecture notes weekly rather than cramming before exams.
9. Instructors use weekly quizzes to ________ how well students understand each concept.
10. An encouraging educational atmosphere helps undergraduates unlock their full ________.
11. Cambridge is known worldwide as a prestigious higher education ________.
12. If you find the research methodology unclear, you can book an appointment with your course ________.
13. In a noisy library café, it can be very difficult to ________ on reading lengthy articles.
14. Candidates with strong ________ credentials have a significant advantage in scholarship competitions.
15. After completing 120 course credits, undergraduates ________ for their bachelor's degree.
16. [Ôn tập Unit 1] Having a balanced daily ________ helps students organize their study hours effectively.
17. [Ôn tập Unit 1] Students organized a recycling campaign to support their local ________.
18. [Ôn tập Unit 1] Last weekend, Sarah worked as a ________ helping new international students register.
19. [Ôn tập Unit 1] Using digital notes instead of paper notebooks is an eco-friendly and ________ practice.
20. [Ôn tập Unit 1] Being informed about world issues helps you become a responsible global ________.
Điểm: 0/20

⚙️ 10 Câu Test Ngữ Pháp Ứng Dụng (Grammar Mastery Test)

1. Last night, David ________ his computer science assignment before 10 PM.
2. Professor Evans ________ at this higher education institution since 2018.
3. ________ you submit the lab report to your tutor yesterday afternoon?
4. Each undergraduate must write ________ academic essay every two weeks.
5. Where is the quiet reading room? It is located in ________ central library.
6. While the professor ________ the complex theory, all students were listening attentively.
7. ________ the research project was demanding, our group finished it before the deadline.
8. Students must maintain self-discipline ________ online courses require independent study.
9. In modern universities, ________ students should collaborate with peers from diverse backgrounds.
10. Two days ago, we ________ our tutor to discuss the upcoming exam preparation.
Điểm: 0/10

Tốc độ đọc:
Trạng thái: Sẵn sàng phát Câu: 0 / 15
💡 Bấm vào bất kỳ câu thoại nào để nghe riêng câu đó:
👩 Advisor: Good morning! Welcome to the University Academic Support Center. How can I assist you today?
👨 Student: Hello Mrs. Evans! I am a first-year student, and I feel a bit overwhelmed by the new university curriculum.
👩 Advisor: That is completely normal for international students. What specific academic challenges are you facing?
👨 Student: Well, we have so many assignments due next week, and I find it quite challenging to concentrate in the busy student hall. 💡 Đáp án câu 1: student hall / hall
👩 Advisor: I understand. Developing solid study discipline takes time. Have you booked a quiet desk in the central library? 💡 Đáp án câu 2: central library / library
👨 Student: Not yet, but I definitely plan to do that this afternoon.
👩 Advisor: Great! Another helpful strategy is to collaborate with your classmates on group revision. 💡 Đáp án câu 3: collaborate
👨 Student: Do you mean forming a study group to prepare for the upcoming mid-term lecture tests?
👩 Advisor: Exactly! Discussing concepts with peers helps you absorb complex academic theories much faster.
👨 Student: That sounds wonderful. How can I get additional guidance from my course tutor?
👩 Advisor: Every faculty tutor holds open office hours on Tuesday and Thursday mornings. You just need to register online. 💡 Đáp án câu 4: Thursday
👨 Student: Thank you! Also, how will our final performance be evaluated at the end of this semester?
👩 Advisor: Your grade combines continuous coursework, project presentations, and a formal written examination in December. 💡 Đáp án câu 5: December
👨 Student: I see. My primary goal is to qualify for the student exchange scholarship to Australia next year. 💡 Đáp án câu 6: scholarship
👩 Advisor: With strong commitment and consistent discipline, you will definitely reach your full potential!
Điểm: 0/6

📰 IELTS Academic Reading: Passage & Questions

[Paragraph A - Campus & Curriculum]
Every year, many young adults enter higher education institutions to start their undergraduate studies. In the first semester, students learn a new academic curriculum with many different subjects. Instead of just listening to theoretical lectures in large halls, learners now have opportunities to collaborate with peers on group projects. This modern method helps students absorb knowledge faster and build confidence.

[Paragraph B - Study Habits & Deadlines]
However, university life also requires strong personal discipline. Undergraduates often receive difficult assignments with strict deadlines. To concentrate well on their studies, learners should establish a quiet daily revision routine in the library. If students have questions about their lessons, they can always ask their course tutor for support.

[Paragraph C - Evaluating Potential]
At the end of each semester, teachers evaluate student progress through tests and practical presentations. When students develop good learning habits, they can unlock their full potential and qualify for great future jobs.
Điểm: 0/6
